pairs: Quis est hic liber repudii matris vestræ,
What is this bill of divorce for your mother,
quo dimisi eam? aut quis est creditor meus,
by which I have dismissed her? Or who is my creditor,
to whom I have sold you?
Ecce in iniquitatibus vestris venditi estis,
Behold, you were sold by your iniquities,
et in sceleribus vestris dimisi matrem vestram.
and I have dismissed your mother for your wickedness.
and there was no one who would hear.
Has my hand been shortened and become small,
et parvula facta est manus mea,
so that I am unable to redeem?
Or is there no power in me to deliver?
aut non est in me virtus ad liberandum?
Ecce in increpatione mea desertum faciam mare,
I will make the sea into a desert.
I will turn rivers into dry land.
The fish will rot for lack of water and will die of thirst.
I will clothe the heavens in darkness,
and I will make sackcloth their covering.
The Lord has given me a learned tongue,
ut sciam sustentare eum qui lassus est verbo.
so that I would know how to uphold with a word, one who has weakened.
he rises to my ear in the morning,
so that I may heed him like a teacher.
The Lord God has opened my ear.
And I do not contradict him.
I have given my body to those who strike me,
and my cheeks to those who plucked them.
faciem meam non averti ab increpantibus et conspuentibus in me.
I have not averted my face from those who rebuked me and who spit on me.
The Lord God is my helper. Therefore,
ideo posui faciem meam ut petram durissimam,
Therefore, I have set my face like a very hard rock,
and I know that I will not be confounded.
He who justifies me is near.
Behold, the Lord God is my helper.
Who is the one who would condemn me?
Behold, they will all be worn away like a garment;
Who is there among you who fears the Lord?
Who hears the voice of his servant?
and there is no light in him?
Let him hope in the name of the Lord,
and let him lean upon his God.
all you who kindle a fire,
walk in the light of your fire and in the flames that you have kindled.
de manu mea factum est hoc vobis:
This has been done to you by my hand.
